title: Use stronger returned trials to certify a small squared response residual
statement: With actual repeatable conditional-iid trials on each persistent specimen and independent new specimens, the multiscale schedule certifies E[(p(H)-c)^2]<=v with the stated broad indifference region at O(v^-1 log^2(1/v)log(1/delta)) trials. It is a stronger access contract than independent two-call ensemble loops. Its v=1/1024 fixture costs1390411776 trials and786336 specimens BEFORE return costs.
